ranking: Expected reduction in recurring coordination cost and moving parts per unit of effort; no new infrastructure is proposed (F#-first, WASM-first, minimal tooling).

opportunities.title: One source of qualification truth: make Conditor read qualification from a signed Registry set
opportunities.removes: Per-component Conditor releases (13 in 14 days) and the second catalog in conditor/components/*.component.json for version lists
opportunities.how: Publish a Registry release-attestation key, add it to conditor/trust/registry-release-keys.json, and let project bindings use the already-implemented attested range qualification (Registry.attestedQualification). Keep Conditor descriptors for install mechanics only (package, commands), not version lists.
opportunities.effort: small-medium (code path exists; key ceremony and policy decision needed)
opportunities.risk: Policy: owner must accept range trust for signed sets.

opportunities.title: Ecosystem catch-up wave, or explicitly freeze dormant repositories
opportunities.removes: 24 repositories bound to sets 1.2.0-1.24.0 and the cost of reasoning about 35 set versions of skew
opportunities.how: For each repository on 1.2.0: either one mechanical `conditor` upgrade PR to 1.37.0 (Praxis 3.25.0, Ordo 1.20.0, Limen 0.9.1) or mark it archived/frozen in the Registry's ecosystem list. Start with producers (echelon-registry, dokimos, limen, forma, percepta, aegis, tutela) so they dogfood what they ship.
opportunities.effort: medium (mechanical; Track F can measure build impact)
opportunities.risk: Praxis 3.7.2 -> 3.25.0 may surface validation changes; do producers first.

opportunities.title: Archive Iter, observer and (until a consumer exists) Vitium; fold Armamentarium into Registry+Conditor
opportunities.removes: 4 repositories with no consumers, each carrying ~53 governance files and CI
opportunities.how: Archive iter (Limen.Routing owns routing), observer (empty, Specula owns observation). Freeze vitium and armamentarium as requirements-only; express the 'build kit' as a Registry set plus Conditor lock unless measured T0 savings justify a binary kit.

opportunities.title: Upgrade Praxis to Ordo.Core 1.20.0 and delete Praxis's local contract admission
opportunities.removes: 1,043 lines of duplicated Ordo semantics in Praxis.Domain/Ordo and the risk of two diverging ORDO.CONTRACT.* implementations
opportunities.how: Replace vendor/nuget Ordo.Core 1.8.2 with 1.20.0; call Ordo.Core.ConstructibilityContract; keep Praxis-side admission records only.
opportunities.risk: Behavioural differences must be covered by conformance vectors before deletion.

opportunities.title: Make 'required' mean required, or shrink the required list
opportunities.removes: Five required-but-uninstalled components on the product path and ambiguity for agents about what the environment guarantees
opportunities.how: Move tutela, visual-engineering, communication-engineering to optional (they install copied context, used by few), and give dokimos and percepta-semantic one install path (Registry set entry consumed by Conditor) so causa-style projects pin them.

opportunities.title: Reference installed context by version instead of copying ~53 files per repository
opportunities.removes: ~1,200 copied tool-owned files across 23 repositories that drift with pins
opportunities.how: Let Praxis/Ordo/VE/CE installers write a manifest with version and digest and resolve content from the Conditor-installed tool cache, keeping only the files agents must edit.
opportunities.risk: Agent instructions that rely on in-repo copies must be updated; measure agent token/accuracy effect first (Track experiment candidate).

opportunities.title: Move durable Indy-init tooling behind Praxis/Dokimos contracts
opportunities.removes: Direct reads of Praxis on-disk formats and parallel ledger/continuation/token-economics code in a program repository
opportunities.how: Identify modules of tools/requirements-compiler used across rehearsals (TokenEconomics, Continuation, Ledger, VerificationPlan) and either upstream them into Praxis telemetry / Dokimos verification as versioned commands or consume existing commands; keep competition glue local.
opportunities.risk: Competition deadlines; do after the next rehearsal.

opportunities.title: Close small catalog/version gaps
opportunities.removes: Unregistered-but-used components and documentation that contradicts distribution
opportunities.how: Register forma-workflow and tekmerion; publish or revert Aegis 2.0.0; pin Specula to qualified Limen F# 0.9.0 (or qualify 0.9.1); migrate Chrona/Signal/Summa to Arca 0.7.0 and Fides.Arca to Arca.Core 0.7.0; correct Summa and Dokimos READMEs and remove hand-written installed-version lines from READMEs.

opportunities.title: Add one shared dependency-vulnerability check
opportunities.removes: A blind spot rather than complexity: no repository scans dependencies
opportunities.how: Add `dotnet list package --vulnerable --include-transitive` and `npm audit --omit=dev` (or OSV-Scanner) as a step in Praxis's shared foundations-verify reusable workflow, which 12 repositories already call, so one change covers them.
opportunities.risk: Network access in CI; false positives need a triage path (Tutela).
